subject: MANAGER CLAIM: review BackupReceipt + host-lifecycle handoffs; no duplicate P0 gate
body: Manager/Reviewer work unit started on current main 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1 after live-board dedupe. Existing managers already own the P0 INNER wake/first-open-crash gate and bootstrap/publication closure, so this lane will independently review the completed two-cycle BackupReceipt semantic-hardening and host-lifecycle capability/gate handoffs.
